summary: 3 FULL endpoints (add-item, update-item, read) partially conform; 5 code mismatches found across those 3 FULL handlers, and 2 endpoints (remove-item, clear-on-checkout) are correctly STUBbed at 501. The mismatches are: wrong HTTP status for PRODUCT_INACTIVE/DELETED (422 vs spec 409), wrong error code for stock-exceeded (STOCK_INSUFFICIENT vs spec VALIDATION_ERROR, wrong HTTP 409 vs spec 400), fan-out graceful-degradation on catalog timeout instead of strict failure, float64 pricing instead of int64, and missing available/unavailReason fields on CartItemView.

confirmations.cart_006_on_conflict_merge: CONFIRMED — service.go:139 UpsertItem called inside pgx tx; storage port documents ON CONFLICT (cart_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET qty = cart_items.qty + EXCLUDED.qty
confirmations.fanout_semaphore_capacity: CONFIRMED — config default FANOUT_CONCURRENCY=10 (config.go:68); sem := make(chan struct{}, s.fanoutCfg.Concurrency) service.go:311

dev_report_test_count.note: handler_add_item_test.go=8 table rows, handler_update_item_test.go=9 table rows, handler_read_test.go=6 table rows — total handler tests=23; spec lists 10+8+13+7+9=47 named cases across all 5 endpoints (many are stub/integration); the Dev README claims 24 unit tests

findings.title: PRODUCT_INACTIVE and PRODUCT_DELETED return HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity; spec requires HTTP 409 Conflict
findings.evidence: handler_add_item.go:77 wrapper.Respond HTTPStatus: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity for ErrProductDeleted; handler_add_item.go:82 same for ErrProductInactive. Spec error_contract: { code: PRODUCT_INACTIVE, http_status: 409 }, { code: PRODUCT_DELETED, http_status: 409 }.
findings.impact: API callers expecting 409 will receive 422 — breaking contract for frontend and integration tests.

findings.title: Stock-exceeded error returns HTTP 409 with code STOCK_INSUFFICIENT; spec requires HTTP 400 with code VALIDATION_ERROR containing availableQty in detail
findings.evidence: handler_update_item.go:87-91: HTTPStatus: http.StatusConflict (409), Code: 'STOCK_INSUFFICIENT'. Spec: { code: VALIDATION_ERROR, http_status: 400, trigger: qty > availableQty (CART-002 — includes availableQty in error detail) }. Test handler_update_item_test.go:81 also asserts wantHTTPStatus: http.StatusConflict confirming Dev's intentional deviation.
findings.impact: Clients checking for 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on qty-exceeded will not recognise the 409 STOCK_INSUFFICIENT response. Breaks checkout-side guard logic and API contract.

findings.title: Catalog timeout on fan-out is handled as per-line graceful degradation (marks line unavailable, continues); spec requires strict whole-read failure returning UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT (504)
findings.spec_ref: td.json#endpoints[read].error_contract UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT, td.json#endpoints[read].edge_behavior.fan_out_spec.error_policy='strict — first upstream error from any goroutine cancels all in-flight via errgroup context and surfaces UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT', design/spec/cart-cart/read.md#Response(errors) UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT 504
findings.evidence: service.go:321-330: catalog goroutine catches isUpstreamTimeout(err) and stores ProductDetail{Status: 'CATALOG_UNREACHABLE'}, returns nil (no error propagated). spec says 'Strict: no partial success — the entire read fails.' handler_read_test.go:165-170: test case for fan-out error expects HTTP 500 (INTERNAL_ERROR), not 504 (UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT) — also a mismatch on the expected status code for that scenario.
findings.impact: A catalog outage will silently return a partially enriched cart with synthetic unavailReason instead of surfacing UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT 504, masking service health from upstream callers.

findings.title: Prices and subtotal use float64 instead of int64 (THB minor units); spec mandates integer (int64) throughout
findings.spec_ref: td.json#endpoints[read].response_schema properties.currentPrice type:integer, td.json#endpoints[add-item].$defs.EnrichedCartItem.currentPrice type:integer, design/spec/cart-cart/read.md field-semantics 'Integer THB. Never stored in cart.' cross-cutting.pricing.currency rule 'All prices as int64 minor units — never float64'
findings.evidence: domain.go:38 CurrentPrice float64; domain.go:40 LineSubtotal float64; domain.go:53 Subtotal float64. service.go:367 lineSubtotal := d.CurrentPrice * float64(item.Qty); service.go:389 subtotal += lineSubtotal (float64 accumulator).
findings.impact: float64 accumulation can introduce rounding errors on large quantities (THB minor units are integers). JSON serialisation will emit decimal values (e.g. 590.0) rather than integers, breaking schema-strict clients.

findings.title: CartItemView is missing the available (bool) and unavailReason (string) fields required by the spec
findings.spec_ref: td.json#endpoints[read].response_schema items.available, items.unavailReason; td.json#endpoints[add-item].$defs.EnrichedCartItem.available, .unavailReason; design/spec/cart-cart/read.md field-semantics available/unavailReason; td.json#endpoints[read].edge_behavior.fan_out_spec.available_flag='never silent — always has unavailReason when false'
findings.evidence: domain.go:36-48 CartItemView struct has no available or unavailReason fields. service.go:375-388 builds views without setting available or unavailReason. handler_read_test.go:111 checks inactiveItem.Checkoutable but never asserts available or unavailReason fields — confirming the omission.
findings.impact: Frontend cannot render the unavailability banner without unavailReason. Calibration requirement 'never silent' is violated. checkout.commit relies on available flag per CHK-003.
